elements.text:
NORTH CAROLINA ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE CONTROL COMMISSION
SPECIAL PURCHASE ALLOWANCE (SPA)
30-DAY PROGRAM

elements.caption: MINIMUM SPA AMOUNTS
elements.summary: Table showing minimum retail discount for eligible sizes.

content.text:
The monthly SPAs must be entered into the NC ABC Commission Pricing System at least ninety
(90) days prior to the month in which the SPA will be offered. The Commission will notify the
local ABC Boards a minimum of sixty (60) days prior to the month of retail reduction.

The SPA item must be a regular listing and have sufficient inventory available for purchase by
ABC Boards during the month in which the case cost and retail price are reduced. Failure to
maintain inventory, may result in the suspension of future SPAs. The Commission may approve
a code for an SPA up to
times in a 12-month period. There must be a

Items submitted for SPA shall not be reduced below the minimum required federal tax
payment on the case.

elements.caption: MONTHLY SPA SUBMITTAL SCHEDULE
elements.summary: Table showing submittal dates for each month of retail sale.

content.text:
*This policy is subject to change. The Commission reserves the right to alter this policy when it is deemed
to be in the best interest of the State of North Carolina.

In the Pricing System, retrieve the product code for which you wish to offer the SPA. In the
Filing Options box, select Monthly Reductions.

elements.alt: Filing Options menu with 'Filing has changed' alert and links to Assign NC Code, Update Item, Edit Filing, Update Image, Show All Filings, Monthly Reductions, and Cancel.

content.text: In the Reductions, select the month and year you wish to add the SPA.

elements.alt: Screenshot of 'Add a new reduced price' with dropdowns for month and year, showing 'Feb' and '2025' selected.

content.text:
Use the Reverse Calculator to calculate the case cost at the reduced retail price, subtract this
case cost from the regular case cost for that month. Enter the differences between the case
costs as the SPA. Then click calculate.

elements.alt: A screenshot of a calculation form with fields for Month Listed for Sale, Current FOB, Freight, Case Cost Less Bailment, and SPA, along with a Calculate button and result fields.

content.text:
*If you add a quarterly price change, you will need to delete then re-add the SPA, as the
updated pricing does not automatically re-calculate. *
